entry_requirements: P6 is accepted with no unresolved stop condition
the candidate compatibility profile and artifact generation are immutable
the target browser, operating-system, hardware, cache, network, deployment, and accessibility populations are approved before budget derivation
required_inputs: accepted POC artifact and compatibility profile identity
native baseline on named reference hardware
metric_contract_requires: product or user constraint served by the metric
browser, operating-system, hardware, cache, network, visibility, and power-state matrix
allowed_derivations: absolute value justified by a documented product constraint
ratio to the named native baseline with an authority-approved coefficient
percentile from retained representative runs with an authority-approved margin
forbidden_derivations: choose a threshold after seeing an implementation result
select a baseline, coefficient, percentile, margin, sample count, population, or exclusion after seeing the candidate result
drop a failing browser, operating-system, hardware, or cold-start population
replace a distribution with the best run
change normalization to hide semantic differences
approve a budget from an unaccepted POC or an incomplete required input
approval_point: after P6 evidence and before Program B/C1 execution
approval_record_requires: derivation and every coefficient or margin
rationale tied to a product or user constraint
insufficient_evidence_rule: missing populations, samples, baselines, constraints, or retained distributions cannot be waived after results; disposition is revise or stop and any revised method is frozen before a newly identified run
change_control: a budget change creates a new decision revision, records evidence and rationale, reruns affected gates, and never rewrites historical dispositions
p0_disposition: the method and anti-gaming rules are P0 inputs; numeric values and their accountable product authority are downstream requirements after P6 and before C1, not P0 blockers
